construct_train_loader: construct a PyTorch training data loader for cifar10 or imagenet datasets with shuffling and drop_last enabled
construct_test_loader: construct a PyTorch test data loader for cifar10 or imagenet datasets without shuffling or dropping the last batch
construct_loader_internal: construct a PyTorch DataLoader for a named dataset with configurable batch size, shuffle, sampler, and drop_last options
shuffle_loader: shuffle a PyTorch data loader by setting the epoch on its DistributedSampler for epoch-based randomization
dataset_catalog: review the dataset catalog mapping cifar10 and imagenet dataset names to their respective PyTorch dataset classes
